decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting draws on the firm's established expertise in robust specialist lighting and its in-house testing and certification, so the firm can interpret results and refine the product, and it has been listed steadily on the website.
General interior lighting is the firm's core competence, and the G2 generation shows continuous in-house development, so absorptive capacity is high and the product is likely to stay.
The microprismatic pendant luminaire builds directly on the firm's proprietary optics R&D and was promoted as a latest release in 2024, which signals strong commitment.

The marine searchlight is more peripheral, and its sibling HMI searchlight was dropped, but the firm's marine and naval know-how and in-house engineering support keeping it, likely as an LED successor.
